name: smwmusic-fury-of-the-storm-winter-storm-ambience
title: Fury of the Storm - Winter Storm Ambience
description:
The sfx used for both the overworld and the "non-level" portions of the 4th Place WLDC2022 Entry "Fury of the Storm." The sample's taken from the 1967 Spider-Man Cartoon, just layered with higher and lower pitches.

Credit isn't necessary, but appreciated nonetheless.
